name: FreeToGame
tagline: Free-to-play MMO and browser games catalog with platform and genre filters
description: FreeToGame provides a public catalog API for free-to-play MMO, multiplayer, and browser games. Developers can list games, filter by platform (PC, browser, etc.) and genre, and fetch game details for discovery apps, recommendation tools, and game directories.

auth.details: No authentication required for public endpoints

use_cases: get details for a free-to-play game by id
build a free-to-play game discovery directory
